narrative.intro: Flightsafety Defense has federal contract obligations of $665M in FY2026 to date. Flightsafety Defense recorded 6 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $111M. Flightsafety Defense obligations are up 778.1% year over year. Flightsafety Defense received most of its FY2026 to date obligations in Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing, which accounts for $641M, followed by Flight Training at $23.8M. Flightsafety Defense current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations, while largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables use total contract values where applicable. Flightsafety Defense figures show a sharp concentration in aircraft parts and auxiliary equipment manufacturing in FY2026 to date. Flightsafety Defense should be evaluated with the understanding that the FY2026 total is a partial year figure and not a full fiscal-year total.
